card.name: End of a brand name or phrase
card.fires_on: The last piece of a drug brand name written in capitals or split into parts, such as VIZIMPRO or LUMAKRAS, and a few phrase-final nouns like contraception or symptoms, in drug label text.

modes.label: Brand name endings
modes.description: Final piece of a split drug brand name, often in section headings or contraindication statements.
modes.example: 7.1 Effects of Other Drugs on LUMAKR<<AS>> Acid-Reducing Agents

modes.label: Phrase-final nouns
modes.description: Noun such as contraception or symptoms that ends a phrase just before a new clause or term.
modes.example: form of hormonal<< contraception>> or an injectable progestin contraceptive

card.plain: It fires when a drug's brand name is just about to end, and sometimes at the end of a phrase like hormonal contraception.
